// uvm_re_match searches the regular expression in the string,
// globs still match whole names, resources with an empty scope are
// only visible in the empty scope, and wait_modified is woken only by
// settings for its own instance.

#include <systemc>
#include <uvm>

using namespace uvm;

static void check(const std::string& what, bool got, bool exp)
{
  std::cout << what << " : " << std::boolalpha << got
            << (got == exp ? "" : " (MISMATCH)") << std::endl;
  if (got != exp)
    UVM_ERROR("CHECK", what);
}

class leaf : public uvm_component
{
 public:
  UVM_COMPONENT_UTILS(leaf);

  bool woken;

  leaf( uvm_component_name name ) : uvm_component(name), woken(false) {}

  virtual void run_phase( uvm_phase& phase )
  {
    uvm_config_db<int>::wait_modified(this, "", "speed");
    woken = true;
  }
};

class test : public uvm_test
{
 public:
  UVM_COMPONENT_UTILS(test);

  leaf* a;
  leaf* b;
  bool top_woken;

  test( uvm_component_name name ) : uvm_test(name), a(nullptr), b(nullptr), top_woken(false) {}

  virtual void build_phase( uvm_phase& phase )
  {
    uvm_test::build_phase(phase);
    a = leaf::type_id::create("a", this);
    b = leaf::type_id::create("b", this);
  }

  void top_waiter()
  {
    uvm_config_db<int>::wait_modified(nullptr, "", "level");
    top_woken = true;
  }

  virtual void run_phase( uvm_phase& phase )
  {
    phase.raise_objection(this);
    sc_core::sc_spawn(sc_core::sc_bind(&test::top_waiter, this));
    sc_core::wait(1, sc_core::SC_NS);
    uvm_config_db<int>::set(this, "a", "speed", 1);
    uvm_config_db<int>::set(nullptr, "", "level", 1);
    sc_core::wait(1, sc_core::SC_NS);
    phase.drop_objection(this);
  }

  virtual void report_phase( uvm_phase& phase )
  {
    // uvm_re_match returns false on a match
    check("regex /env/ in test.env.agent", !uvm_re_match("/env/", "test.env.agent"), true);
    check("regex /^env/ in test.env.agent", !uvm_re_match("/^env/", "test.env.agent"), false);
    check("glob env matches test.env.agent", uvm_is_match("env", "test.env.agent"), false);
    check("glob *env* matches test.env.agent", uvm_is_match("*env*", "test.env.agent"), true);
    check("glob test.env matches test.env.agent", uvm_is_match("test.env", "test.env.agent"), false);

    int v = 0;
    uvm_config_db<int>::set(nullptr, "/env/", "cfg", 5);
    check("config /env/ found in test.env.agent",
          uvm_config_db<int>::get(nullptr, "test.env.agent", "cfg", v) && v == 5, true);
    check("config /env/ found in test.agent",
          uvm_config_db<int>::get(nullptr, "test.agent", "cfg", v), false);

    uvm_resource_db<int>::set("", "empty_scope", 7);
    check("empty scope resource found in \"\"",
          uvm_resource_db<int>::read_by_name("", "empty_scope", v) && v == 7, true);
    check("empty scope resource found in test.env",
          uvm_resource_db<int>::read_by_name("test.env", "empty_scope", v), false);

    check("wait_modified(a) woken by set(this, \"a\")", a->woken, true);
    check("wait_modified(b) woken by set(this, \"a\")", b->woken, false);
    check("wait_modified(nullptr, \"\") woken by set(nullptr, \"\")", top_woken, true);
  }
};

int sc_main(int, char*[])
{
  run_test("test");
  return 0;
}
